verdict.rationale: Stripe's Agentic Commerce Suite routes agent traffic only through registered agents. Sellers pick an agent in the Dashboard and review its terms, the agent must accept an approval request, and an OCA (agent–seller connection) is required before agentic flows are authorized. Completed orders are then tagged and filterable by originating agent, with an agent_details field in private preview. However, nothing documents cryptographic agent signatures, trust tiers, or a way to verify agent identity on arbitrary traffic so merchants can tell it apart from anonymous bots. Missing for 10: verifiable agent signatures or credentials, trust-tier classification, a mechanism for separating anonymous bot traffic, GA status beyond private preview, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, agents identify themselves verifiably — registered profiles, signatures, or trust tiers — so I can tell trusted agent traffic from anonymous bots

citations.quote: Find the agent you want to sell through and review its terms
